comparison.objective: Scrape a stuck print from a build plate and place it in a basket; unlike shock-absorber commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp a scraper, insert its thin blade under an edge, lever the print free, and transfer it; no rotary tuning or locking.
comparison.success_condition: Print freed and placed in basket, plate left in printer, scraper returned to table. Force/damage thresholds and spec versions are not given.
comparison.reason: Tests tool-mediated separation and transfer rather than setting and validating a damper.
